title: Looming Fruit
description: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]31[/blue].
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: This relic has a cosmetic variant (cornucopia or default) that is locked per player based on their unique ID (50% chance). The mechanical effect is identical regardless of variant — it always grants 31 Max HP on pickup. Other players can see your variant to infer your account's ID parity.
